quests.title: Backup Plans

dialogue.t: Hmm... Should I continue my research or not?
To be precise, this is a testing platform for Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1, the latest stealth robot of Aino's design.
She recently purchased an abandoned cleaning bot from the black market. After modifying it, she created the Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 you see here today.
This platform has simulated several hostile environments to test the robot's ability to maintain stealth under pressure.
Why's Aino making this stealth robot again?
After the theft of Krum-Clank 70% Sweet, Aino made up her mind, and declared: "No matter how powerful the foe, we have to rescue our friends!"
Then she quickly completed the draft of Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1 and started its development.
According to her plan, once the development is complete, it should be able to infiltrate even the heavily guarded Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau with ease to rescue our friends.
But Aino soon realized that perfecting the plan would take far too long — so she wanted to abandon the idea. As per her calculations, it would be much faster to just turn all of Nod-Krai upside down.
I've made up my mind! Since we're taking things nice, chill, and easy, I'll just keep working on Zip-Zap Spy-Bot Number 1! It'll definitely help us save our friends!
In that case, could we ask you two to assist with the tests?
Based on past statistics, having data provided by other testers as reference will increase Aino's development speed by at least 30%.
Count Paimon in! This sounds like fun!
Then I thank you both on Aino's behalf. I will grant you access permissions to the platform — from now on, you can use it for any testing you need to conduct.

quests.description: Aino’s working on a backup plan to save her friends…
